title.zh: 数字复算、脚本核算与总成本
title.en: Recomputable numbers, scripted calculation and total cost

text.zh: 关键数字附可复算的推导公式与适用场景；比较方案前先量化双方总成本，再讨论体验与取舍。复杂或较长的计算必须通过实际执行的脚本或代码复算，核对输入、公式、单位和结果，不能只依赖语言模型心算或生成未经运行的代码。保留可复现的计算依据；无法完成复算时明确标记未验证。
text.en: Attach a recomputable derivation formula and its applicable scenario to key numbers. Before comparing options, quantify the total cost of each, then discuss experience and trade-offs. Complex or long calculations must be rechecked by actually executing a script or code, verifying inputs, formulas, units and results; do not rely on mental arithmetic by the language model or on code that was never run. Keep a reproducible basis for the calculation; when recomputation cannot be completed, mark the result as unverified.

zh: 选择本模板的环境；按正文条件适用
en: Where the template is selected; applies under the conditions in the text

trigger.zh: 给出关键数字、比较方案，或进行较复杂、较长的计算时
trigger.en: When giving key numbers, comparing options, or doing complex or long calculations

purpose.zh: 让数字可复算、可核对，避免心算或未经运行的代码带来的错误
purpose.en: Keep numbers recomputable and checkable, avoiding errors from mental arithmetic or code that was never run

exclude.zh: 不含关键数字、成本比较或计算的内容
exclude.en: Content with no key numbers, cost comparison or calculation
